title: Ring push guide: multi-device forking races
description: Section on the first-to-answer race. Push delivered to N devices simultaneously. First VTCParticipant/set update wins. Server dispatches VTCCallEndEvent answered_elsewhere to losers. Edge cases: two devices answer within the same server tick, network partitions, push delivery ordering. Idempotency of answer operations. Client-side UX for answered_elsewhere (dismiss call UI, show toast).
